title: Return Transition at a Nonblank Cell
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ and $y$ be bit strings, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. Choose a selector bit vector, an input-head position for the simulated machine on $y$, the simulated work tapes and head positions, and two auxiliary tapes with head positions. If the first auxiliary tape contains the bit $v$ at its head position $z_C$, then one step of the tabulating machine from the corresponding return-state configuration leaves the state and all specified data unchanged except that this tape's head moves from $z_C$ to $z_C-1$.
